deals.title: lululemon Black Friday Specials: Up to 84% off + free shipping
deals.descriptionHtml:
lululemon's Black Friday Specials are now live, with markdowns as high as 84%. Women's clothing and accessories see the highest of these discounts, but there's also around 50% off on lots of men's items and bags, as well as big drops on running shoes. Plus, it's not just summer clothing, as lots of pants, sweaters, and layers are good for winter (albeit in last season's colors). Everything ships for free, too. Some standout deals include the lululemon 28" Wunder Train High-Rise Tights at $59, down from $98, and the lululemon 28" Align High-Rise Pants, also $59. Bags and gear include the 22L Everywhere Backpack at $44 and the 32L Scuba Backpack at $64. Stock never lasts long, so be quick to get the best sizes.  Shop Now at lululemon

Features
  • Women's, men's, bags, accessories, and shoes included
  • Leggings from $59, down from $98
  • Backpacks from $44
  • Running shoes at $99, down from $158
  • Sports bras and tank tops from $39
  • Shorts from $39

deals.title: Mamazing GrowPod Pro Wooden Baby High Chair for $160 + free shipping
deals.descriptionHtml:
Make family mealtimes easier with this adjustable wooden high chair that grows with your child, features dishwasher-safe trays for easy cleanup, and folds compactly for storage. It's currently $90 off the $250 list price. Deal ends November 26.  Buy Now at Amazon

Features
  • Fits babies from 6 months up to 220-lbs.
  • Converts to a standard dining chair for older kids & adults
  • Dual removable tray with cover is dishwasher safe
  • 5-point harness, footrest, & tool-free height adjustment
  • Folds for storage

deals.title: Staples Black Friday Sale: Up to 50% off + free delivery on lots of items
deals.descriptionHtml:
The Staples Black Friday Sale is now live for EasyRewards members (if you're not a member, it's free to sign up). Once signed in, you can get up to 50% off across the store and free shipping on lots of items. The sale includes laptops, tech accessories, office and gaming chairs, custom printing, toys, games, puzzles, and luggage. Deals are available online and in store, with 1-hour store pickup as an option for faster orders. This deal ends November 21. Shop Now at Staples

Features
  • Early access Black Friday deals end 11/21
  • Free delivery on select items
  • Categories include laptops, tech, chairs, custom print, toys & games, and travel
  • Available online and in store
  • 1-hour store pickup and same-day delivery via Instacart
